name: @beachside/vercel

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target node --format esm --outdir dist --external @beachside/adapter --external tar-stream --external zod && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit false --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist && bun ../../../scripts/rewrite-declarations.mjs

description: Vercel Sandbox adapter for Beachside with immutable sessions, snapshots and binary IO.
